topic: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill four Palestinians, including a child

en.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill four Palestinians, including a child
en.dek: Reports from Gaza say Israeli attacks killed four or five people, including a child, on 5 November 2026, with outlets citing different tolls.
facts: The New Arab and Middle East Eye reported five deaths in Gaza, including a child.
Haaretz and Muslim Network TV reported four Palestinians killed.
Al Arabiya cited Gaza's civil defense in reporting four deaths, including a child.
Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency reported four Palestinians killed in attacks across Gaza.
Democracy Now described the toll as at least four.
All reports were published on 5 November 2026.
body: Outlets reported different death tolls from Israeli attacks in Gaza on 5 November 2026, and the accounts split between four and five deaths. The New Arab and Middle East Eye said five people were killed, including a child. Haaretz and Muslim Network TV reported four Palestinians killed.
The New Arab and Middle East Eye published their reports on 5 November 2026, and both said the attacks killed five people, including a child.
Haaretz and Muslim Network TV also published their reports on 5 November 2026, and both reported that four Palestinians were killed.
Al Arabiya cited Gaza's civil defense in reporting that Israeli fire killed four people, including a child. Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency reported four Palestinians killed in attacks across Gaza.
Democracy Now described the toll as at least four, and its report was published on 5 November 2026.
Coverage published during the evening of 5 November 2026 showed a difference between four and five deaths, and the reports described attacks across Gaza on the same day.
Eight news outlets reported on the attacks, and their accounts differ on the exact number of deaths.
en.context: All reports were published on 5 November 2026. Al Arabiya cited Gaza's civil defense for its casualty figure. The attacks took place across Gaza, according to Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency.

en.dek: Palestinian civil defense and local authorities reported that Israeli attacks across Gaza killed four people, including a child, and wounded 11 others.
en.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill four Palestinians, including a child

de.title: Israelische Angriffe im Gazastreifen töten vier Palästinenser, darunter ein Kind
de.dek: Der palästinensische Zivilschutz und örtliche Behörden meldeten, dass israelische Angriffe im gesamten Gazastreifen vier Menschen töteten, darunter ein Kind, und 11 weitere verletzten.

fr.title: Les attaques israéliennes à Gaza font quatre morts parmi les Palestiniens, dont un enfant
fr.dek: La protection civile palestinienne et les autorités locales ont signalé que les attaques israéliennes à Gaza avaient tué quatre personnes, dont un enfant, et blessé 11 autres.

es.title: Los ataques de Israel en Gaza dejan muertos a cuatro palestinos, incluido un niño
es.dek: Los servicios de defensa civil palestinos y las autoridades locales informaron de que los ataques de Israel en toda Gaza mataron a cuatro personas, incluido un niño, y hirieron a otras 11.

zh.title: 以色列袭击加沙致四名巴勒斯坦人死亡，包括一名儿童
zh.dek: 巴勒斯坦民防部门和地方当局称，以色列在加沙各地的袭击造成四人死亡，其中包括一名儿童，另有11人受伤。

ko.title: 가자지구에 대한 이스라엘 공격으로 팔레스타인인 4명 사망, 어린이 포함
ko.dek: 팔레스타인 민방위 당국과 현지 당국은 가자지구 전역에서 발생한 이스라엘 공격으로 어린이를 포함한 4명이 숨지고 11명이 부상했다고 밝혔다.

pt.title: Ataques israelitas em Gaza matam quatro palestinianos, incluindo uma criança
pt.dek: A defesa civil palestiniana e as autoridades locais relataram que ataques israelitas em Gaza mataram quatro pessoas, incluindo uma criança, e feriram outras 11.

ja.title: イスラエルのガザ攻撃でパレスチナ人4人死亡、子ども含む
ja.dek: パレスチナ民間防衛当局と地方当局は、イスラエルによるガザ各地での攻撃で、子どもを含む4人が死亡し、11人が負傷したと発表した。

it.title: Attacchi israeliani a Gaza uccidono quattro palestinesi, tra cui un bambino
it.dek: La difesa civile palestinese e le autorità locali hanno riferito che attacchi israeliani in diverse zone di Gaza hanno ucciso quattro persone, tra cui un bambino, e ferito altre 11.

en.headline: Outlets report different Gaza death tolls after Israeli attacks
en.body: The New Arab and Middle East Eye reported five deaths in Gaza, including a child, while Haaretz and Muslim Network TV reported four Palestinians killed. All four reports were published on 5 November 2026.

es.headline: Medios informan de diferentes balances de muertos en Gaza tras ataques israelíes
es.body: The New Arab y Middle East Eye informaron de cinco muertos en Gaza, incluido un niño, mientras que Haaretz y Muslim Network TV informaron de la muerte de cuatro palestinos. Los cuatro informes se publicaron el 5 de noviembre de 2026.

fr.headline: Des médias rapportent des bilans de décès différents à Gaza après des attaques israéliennes
fr.body: The New Arab et Middle East Eye ont fait état de cinq morts à Gaza, dont un enfant, tandis que Haaretz et Muslim Network TV ont signalé la mort de quatre Palestiniens. Les quatre articles ont été publiés le 5 novembre 2026.

de.headline: Medien berichten nach israelischen Angriffen von unterschiedlichen Todeszahlen in Gaza
de.body: The New Arab und Middle East Eye berichteten von fünf Todesopfern in Gaza, darunter einem Kind, während Haaretz und Muslim Network TV von vier getöteten Palästinensern berichteten. Alle vier Berichte wurden am 5. November 2026 veröffentlicht.

it.headline: Diverse testate riportano differenti numeri di vittime a Gaza dopo gli attacchi israeliani
it.body: The New Arab e Middle East Eye hanno riportato cinque morti a Gaza, tra cui un bambino, mentre Haaretz e Muslim Network TV hanno riportato quattro palestinesi uccisi. Tutti e quattro i servizi sono stati pubblicati il 5 novembre 2026.

pt.headline: Meios de comunicação noticiam números diferentes de mortos em Gaza após ataques israelitas
pt.body: The New Arab e Middle East Eye noticiaram cinco mortos em Gaza, incluindo uma criança, enquanto Haaretz e Muslim Network TV noticiaram quatro palestinianos mortos. As quatro notícias foram publicadas a 5 de novembro de 2026.

ko.headline: 이스라엘 공격 후 가자 사망자 수, 매체별로 엇갈려
ko.body: 더 뉴 아랍과 미들 이스트 아이는 어린이 1명을 포함해 가자에서 5명이 사망했다고 보도한 반면, 하아레츠와 무슬림 네트워크 TV는 팔레스타인인 4명이 숨졌다고 전했다. 이 4개 보도는 모두 2026년 11월 5일에 나왔다.

zh.headline: 以军袭击后 不同媒体报告的加沙死亡人数不一
zh.body: 《新阿拉伯人报》和《中东之眼》报道称，加沙有5人死亡，其中包括一名儿童；《国土报》和穆斯林网络电视则报道称，4名巴勒斯坦人被打死。这四篇报道均发表于2026年11月5日。

ja.headline: イスラエル攻撃後のガザの死者数、各メディアで異なる報道
ja.body: The New ArabとMiddle East Eyeは、子ども1人を含むガザでの5人の死亡を報じた一方、HaaretzとMuslim Network TVはパレスチナ人4人が殺害されたと報じた。4つの報道はすべて2026年11月5日に公開された。

Al Jazeera und die Anadolu-Agentur berichteten, dass bei Angriffen im Gazastreifen vier Palästinenser getötet wurden, während Democracy Now die Zahl der Todesopfer mit mindestens vier angab.

en.body: Al Arabiya, citing Gaza's civil defense, reported that Israeli fire killed four people, including a child. Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency reported four Palestinians killed in attacks across Gaza, while Democracy Now described the toll as at least four.
en.headline: Four Palestinians, including a child, killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza

es.body: Al Arabiya, citando a la defensa civil de Gaza, informó de que el fuego israelí mató a cuatro personas, incluido un niño. Al Jazeera y la Agencia Anadolu informaron de cuatro palestinos muertos en ataques en toda Gaza, mientras Democracy Now describió el balance de víctimas como de al menos cuatro.
es.headline: Cuatro palestinos, incluido un niño, mueren en ataques de Israel en Gaza

fr.body: Al Arabiya, citant les services de protection civile de Gaza, a fait état de quatre personnes tuées, dont un enfant, par les tirs israéliens. Al Jazeera et l’agence Anadolu ont rapporté que quatre Palestiniens avaient été tués lors d’attaques dans toute la bande de Gaza, tandis que Democracy Now a qualifié le bilan d’au moins quatre morts.
fr.headline: Quatre Palestiniens, dont un enfant, tués lors d’attaques israéliennes dans toute la bande de Gaza

it.body: Al Arabiya, citando la protezione civile di Gaza, ha riferito che il fuoco israeliano ha ucciso quattro persone, tra cui un bambino. Al Jazeera e l'Agenzia Anadolu hanno riferito di quattro palestinesi uccisi in attacchi in tutta Gaza, mentre Democracy Now ha descritto il bilancio come almeno di quattro persone uccise.
it.headline: Quattro palestinesi, tra cui un bambino, uccisi dagli attacchi israeliani in tutta Gaza

ja.body: ガザの民防当局を引用したアル・アラビヤは、イスラエルの砲火で子どもを含む4人が死亡したと報じた。アル・ジェazeeraとアナドルー通信社は、ガザ全域の攻撃で4人のパレスチナ人が死亡したと報じた。一方、デモクラシー・ナウは死亡者数を少なくとも4人とした。
ja.headline: ガザ全域のイスラエルの攻撃で、子どもを含む4人のパレスチナ人が死亡

pt.body: A Al Arabiya, citando a defesa civil de Gaza, informou que o fogo israelita matou quatro pessoas, incluindo uma criança. A Al Jazeera e a Agência Anadolu informaram que quatro palestinianos foram mortos em ataques em toda a Gaza, enquanto a Democracy Now descreveu o bilan de mortos como sendo de pelo menos quatro.
pt.headline: Quatro palestinianos, incluindo uma criança, mortos em ataques israelitas em Gaza

zh.body: 阿拉比亚电视台援引加沙民防部门报道称，以色列炮火造成4人死亡，其中包括一名儿童。半岛电视台和阿纳多卢通讯社报道称，加沙各地遭袭共造成4名巴勒斯坦人死亡；《民主现在》则称死亡人数至少为4人。
zh.headline: 加沙各地遭以色列袭击，4名巴勒斯坦人死亡，包括一名儿童

ko.headline: 가자 전역 이스라엘 공격으로 어린이 포함 팔레스타인인 4명 사망
ko.body: 알 아라비야는 가자 민방위를 인용해 이스라엘군 발포로 어린이 1명을 포함한 4명이 숨졌다고 보도했다. 알 자지라와 아나돌루 통신은 가자 전역 공격으로 팔레스타인인 4명이 사망했다고 전했으며, 데모크러시 나우는 사망자 수를 최소 4명으로 보도했다.
